# Acutest

This directory vendors `acutest.h` from the official
[mity/acutest](https://github.com/mity/acutest) repository at commit
`31751b4089c93b46a9fd8a8183a695f772de66de`.

Acutest is used only to build the repository test executables. Its MIT license is preserved in
`LICENSE.md` and at the beginning of `acutest.h`.

Do not format or modify the vendored files. Update them by replacing the files from a reviewed,
explicitly pinned upstream commit and recording the new commit identifier here.
